== Geology ==
This volcano which is about three times the area of its capping glacier is in the Western volcanic zone. It rises over 1,000 m (3,300 ft) above its surrounds and was formed presumably by mongenetic subglacial volcanic activity. It is currently dormant or more likely extinct in terms of volcanic activity.  The lowest 350 m (1,150 ft) is a hyaloclastite (móberg) tuya, capped by a 750 m (2,460 ft) thick basaltic lava shield. The volcano is also a composite volcano.


== Glacier ==
